# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A strong opening gap up that holds above VWAP but shows weakening ribbon and bearish price action predicts a reversion to VWAP. The setup captures short-side mean-reversion after an overextended gap-up open, using VWAP as a dynamic support/resistance and EMA ribbon bias to filter for bearish momentum, with a bearish engulfing candle as the entry trigger.

## Mechanism

Entry: If today's open > prior close * 1.003 (gap up >0.3%) AND price at 15‑min mark > VWAP AND EMA9 < EMA21 (ribbon bearish) AND a bearish engulfing candle forms (close < prior open AND open > prior close) AND the candle's upper wick (high - close) > 2 * (open - close) THEN enter short at the close of that engulfing bar.
Exit: Initial stop at opening range high (ORH) + 0.5*ATR(5); first target at 1.5R to VWAP; trail remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR*3) after 1R is reached.
Regime filter: Only trade when VIX < 20 and avoid when VIX >25 or when EMA9 > EMA21 > EMA50 (strongly bullish ribbon). Trade only in the first 30 minutes after open.
